entries.title: Chocolate chip chunk cookies
entries.description:
1. brown 113 g salted butter and let cool slightly
2. mix in 60 g brown sugar and 45 g white sugar
3. mix in 1 medium egg and 1½ tsp vanilla extract
4. fold in 175 g flour and ½ tsp baking soda
5. fold in 45 g chocolate chips and 45 g chopped chocolate
6. refrigerate for 30–45 minutes
7. divide into 8 balls and flatten slightly
8. bake at 375°F for 12–15 minutes
9. cool on the baking sheet for 5–8 minutes, wire rack for 10 minutes
